assessments.reasoning: The Commodore guide's ARexx versus REXX section expressly identifies the first edition of Mike Cowlishaw's book as the basis and explains Amiga additions to built-in functions. That language and edition scope supports the direction from REXX to the ARexx implementation.

challenge.method: Compare the first-edition scope with the adjacent language-feature and built-in additions and the author’s original REXX design account. Challenge whether common branding or interpreter support alone could establish the link.
challenge.results: The explicit implementation sentence supplies the link. The additions and edition language delimit the basis. This supports a historical implementation relationship, with complete conformance and later version evidence outside its reach.

limitations: The cited implementation basis is Cowlishaw's first-edition language description. The finding does not infer later-standard conformance or identical built-ins.
